title: AI Cleaner: Storage Cleanup
summary: Clean storage fast with AI. Remove duplicates & compress photo.
description:
AI Cleaner: Smart Phone Cleaner

Is your phone running out of storage?
AI Cleaner helps you clean junk files, remove unnecessary data, and clear space so you can better manage storage on your device.

🧹 Clean Junk & Free Up Storage
Easily remove unwanted files that take up space on your device.
AI Cleaner can identify large files, unnecessary photos, and storage-heavy content so you can clean your phone more efficiently.

Free up storage with simple steps and organize your files more easily.

📊 Smart Storage Analysis
Know what’s using your storage in seconds and make better decisions before deleting anything.
Get a clear overview of your photos and videos with detailed insights into total size and usage.

🧠 AI Photo Cleaner
Quickly clean your gallery with smart grouping:
• Duplicate photos
• Similar photos
• Blurry photos
• Screenshots & similar screenshots
Select the best photos and remove the rest to save space while keeping your important memories.

📹 AI Video Cleaner
AI Cleaner helps you remove unnecessary video files, freeing up more space with just a few taps.
• Similar Videos – Detect and remove videos that are almost identical.
• Duplicate Videos – Get rid of duplicate files occupying extra storage.
• Short Recordings – Remove short video clips that are taking up space.
• Screen Recordings – Clean up screen recordings that you no longer need.
• All Videos – Manage and organize all your video files for better space usage.

👉 Swipe to Clean Faster
Clean your phone with simple gestures:
• Swipe left to delete unwanted files (review before deleting)
• Swipe right to keep or review later

A simple way to declutter your storage.

📦 Compress Photos & Videos
Reduce file size and save more space:
• Compress large photos and videos
• Choose your preferred compression level
• Keep or replace original files

Free up storage without losing important content.

🔒 Private & Secure Cleaning
Cleaning processes are designed to support on-device operations where applicable.
Your data is handled with a focus on user privacy.

Clean your phone and manage storage with AI Cleaner.
